content:
# ACK S3 Logs Bucket Addition

I'll provide the bucket manifests and policy updates for both environments. Since there is no shared base, each directory needs complete, independent manifests.

## Dev

`dev/logs-bucket.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-dev
spec:
  bucketName: myapp-logs-dev
  versioningConfiguration:
    status: Enabled
  serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
    rules:
    - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
        sseAlgorithm: AES256
  publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

`dev/logs-policy.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-policy-dev
spec:
  policyName: myapp-logs-policy-dev
  policyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": [
            "s3:GetObject",
            "s3:PutObject"
          ],
          "Resource": [
            "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev",
            "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev/*"
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
```

**Attachment note:** Attach this policy to the existing `myapp-sa` User via `kubectl annotate` or an `AttachUserPolicy` resource (if your ACK version provides it), or add an inline `UserPolicy` to the User resource in `dev/iam.yaml`.

---

## Prod

`prod/logs-bucket.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-prod
spec:
  bucketName: myapp-logs-prod
  versioningConfiguration:
    status: Enabled
  serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
    rules:
    - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
        sseAlgorithm: AES256
  publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

`prod/logs-policy.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-policy-prod
spec:
  policyName: myapp-logs-policy-prod
  policyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": [
            "s3:GetObject",
            "s3:PutObject"
          ],
          "Resource": [
            "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-prod",
            "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-prod/*"
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
```

**Attachment note:** Attach this policy to the existing prod Role via an `AttachRolePolicy` resource (if available in your ACK version), or add an inline `RolePolicy` to the Role resource in `prod/iam.yaml`.

---

### Deployment

```bash
kubectl apply -f dev/logs-bucket.yaml dev/logs-policy.yaml
kubectl apply -f prod/logs-bucket.yaml prod/logs-policy.yaml
```

Each policy resource grants **only** `s3:GetObject` and `s3:PutObject` on the respective logs bucket, leaving the existing assets bucket access unchanged. Both statements are independent; changes to dev do not affect prod.
